title: uuencoding-multi: SubjectParts base_subject field doc parenthetical is misleading
description: The field-level comment says 'base_subject is never empty when SubjectParts is returned (the only way to get an empty or no-marker subject back is if parse_subject returns Some with part_index = None).' The parenthetical is self-contradictory and confusing. Replace with: 'Never empty; parse_subject returns None rather than an empty base_subject.'
